content.json:
# Enterprise AI Gateway — Observability
Token usage, cost allocation, cache effectiveness, backend routing/failover, throttling, and content-safety governance. Metrics are sourced from APIM AI-gateway policies (structured `traces` + `customMetrics` via `llm-emit-token-metric`). Costs are **estimates** and mirror `packages/shared/src/cost.ts`.

parameters.name: Tier
parameters.query: traces | where message has 'ai_gateway_request' | extend d=parse_json(message) | distinct tostring(d.consumerTier)

content.query: traces | where message has 'ai_gateway_request' | extend d=parse_json(message) | where '{Tier}' == '*' or tostring(d.consumerTier) == '{Tier}' | summarize Requests=count(), Success=countif(toint(d.httpStatus) between (200 .. 299)), Failed=countif(not(toint(d.httpStatus) between (200 .. 299))) | extend Metrics = pack_array(pack('Label','Requests','Value',Requests), pack('Label','Success','Value',Success), pack('Label','Failed','Value',Failed)) | mv-expand Metrics | project Label=tostring(Metrics.Label), Value=tolong(Metrics.Value)
content.title: Request outcomes

content.query: traces | where message has 'ai_gateway_request' | extend d=parse_json(message) | summarize Requests=count(), Hits=countif(tostring(d.cacheStatus)=='hit') by bin(timestamp,1h) | extend HitRatePct=round(100.0*Hits/Requests,1) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Cache hit rate over time

content.query: traces | where message has 'ai_gateway_request' | extend d=parse_json(message) | summarize Requests=count(), Failovers=countif(tobool(d.failover)) by Backend=tostring(d.backend)
content.title: Backend distribution & failover

content.query: let InputPrice=dynamic({'fast':0.00015,'balanced':0.0025,'reasoning':0.0011}); let OutputPrice=dynamic({'fast':0.0006,'balanced':0.01,'reasoning':0.0044}); customMetrics | where name in ('Prompt Tokens','Completion Tokens') | extend ConsumerId=tostring(customDimensions.ConsumerId), Customer=tostring(customDimensions.Customer), Department=tostring(customDimensions.Department), ModelAlias=tostring(customDimensions.ModelAlias) | summarize tokens=sum(valueSum) by name, ConsumerId, Customer, Department, ModelAlias | extend rate=iff(name=='Prompt Tokens', todouble(InputPrice[ModelAlias]), todouble(OutputPrice[ModelAlias])) | extend estCostUsd=tokens/1000.0*rate | summarize EstimatedCostUsd=round(sum(estCostUsd),4) by ConsumerId, Customer, Department, ModelAlias | order by EstimatedCostUsd desc
content.title: Cost allocation (estimate) by consumer / customer / department / model

content.query: traces | where message has 'ai_gateway_request' | extend d=parse_json(message) | where toint(d.httpStatus)==429 | summarize Throttled=count() by ConsumerId=tostring(d.consumerId), Tier=tostring(d.consumerTier) | order by Throttled desc
content.title: Throttling by consumer

content.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where ApiId == 'ai-gateway' | summarize p50=percentile(TotalTime,50), p95=percentile(TotalTime,95), p99=percentile(TotalTime,99) by bin(TimeGenerated,1h) | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Latency percentiles (ms)
